---

## 1. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY

Fleet average RT settled at **$30.18/MWh**, up sharply from $28.34 the prior day and representing the highest fleet average in the four-day trailing window (+28% vs. the $23.53 average from 07-26). The single most notable event was **MAINLAND_RN**, which spiked to **$410.67/MWh** in RT — the lone node exceeding $100/MWh — driven by binding constraint **STPWAP39_1** (STP→WAP), which held for 11 hours with a peak shadow of $318.75/MWh at HE17. Any HEN asset dispatching RT at MAINLAND captured an outsized premium; its DART of **-$3.30/MWh** (RT exceeded DA by $3.30) confirms RT outperformance there. At the opposite end, **TYNAN_RN** posted negative RT prices, penalizing any RT-exposed position at that node, though its 5-day Sharpe of **+1.011** validates the standing DA commitment strategy. **OLNEYTN_RN** led the fleet in DA premium capture at **$12.02/MWh** (DA exceeded RT), followed closely by **RUSSEKST_RN** at **$11.31/MWh** — both representing strong DA lock-in value for those positions.

The 7-day forecast across ERCOT is uniformly extreme, with temperatures ranging from **96–107°F** across all major load zones through August 5.
